newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 30.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 179.01 points -- its second biggest one-day point gain -- to close at 6,962.03 points after a pair of economic reports soothed investor jitters about inflation.

* The Dow rally started after the government said that a key gauge of wage and benefit costs rose 0.6 percent in the first quarter, off from 0.8 percent in the fourth quarter and below forecasts for a 0.9 percent rise.
* A separate report said orders for long-lasting durable goods fell 3 percent in March, the biggest monthly decline since a 3.6 percent fall last August.

* Indonesian troops and riot police blocked thousands of supporters of the Moslem-oriented United Development Party from parading illegally on major Jakarta roads on Tuesday as the country's general election campaign gathered momentum but there were no reports of violence or arrests.
* On Tuesday, the composite index fell 9.3 points to close at 647.23 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,431.00/32.50 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,429.50/30.50.
* Property firm Elang after reports that the Bakrie Group, which has a majority stake in Elang, planned to place its property projects under Elang.
* Property firms Putra Surya and Dharmala Intiland following announcement of rises in their 1996 net profits.
* Finance firm Multidana which was heavily traded on Tuesday.
* Small property firm Suryamas on a newspaper report it had formed a link-up with two foreign firms.
